dataset.split: the exact test JSONs shipped by the official evaluator

protocol.question: How would you rate the quality of this image?
protocol.answer_prefix: The quality of the image is
protocol.score_definition: softmax over the five score-token logits followed by their weighted sum
protocol.preprocessing: RGB; expand to square using image_processor.image_mean*255 background; official image_processor.preprocess; FP16

metrics.SRCC: Spearman rank correlation between predicted scores and gt_score
metrics.PLCC: Pearson correlation between predicted scores and gt_score
metrics.KRCC: Kendall tau-b correlation between predicted scores and gt_score
metrics.reporting_direction: Report correlation magnitude, as in the official positive-valued IQA table; retain raw signed correlation to expose MOS/DMOS label direction

excluded.reason: The user requested official evaluation data only; these sets are marked seen or are used for OneAlign training.
